create_linear_space_eager: create a sequence of evenly-spaced numeric points between start and end with a given number of samples using linear_space
create_linear_space_temporal: create a sequence of evenly-spaced time values between two temporal endpoints using linear_space
create_linear_space_closed_interval: create evenly-spaced points with a specific closed interval option like left, right, none, or both using linear_space
create_linear_space_expr: generate a linear space expression for use in a polars dataframe pipeline without immediate evaluation
create_linear_spaces_per_row: generate per-row linear space sequences between start and end columns with variable num_samples using linear_spaces
